drivingQuestion: Is the baraita on square tefillin already taught in the mishna?

segments.he: אָמַר רַב פָּפָּא: מַתְנִיתִין דַּעֲבִידָא כִּי אַמְגּוּזָא.
segments.en: «Rav Pappa said:» It is possible to understand that «the mishna» is referring to phylacteries «that one constructed» to be round «like a nut,» i.e., in the shape of a ball. However, the mishna does not indicate that the phylacteries must be square, as it does not address the case of phylacteries that are rounded but not a true sphere.

moves.summary: rejects the redundancy suggestion: mishna speaks of nut-shaped tefillin
moves.about: the mishna does not already teach the square requirement, since it speaks only of a sphere

edges.about: the mishna's round tefillin are nut-shaped spheres
the mishna does not already teach the square requirement, since it speaks only of a sphere

positions.claim: the mishna refers to spherical tefillin
